title: Tighten S2.4 relation refusal assertions and test the bound-ancestor branch
outcome: Tighten S2.4 relation refusal assertions and test the bound-ancestor branch
acceptance: The S2.4 relation refusal tests in src/storage/work/task_sync/tests/folder_apply/relations.rs assert the exact `{owner}: reason (detail)` text (ancestor_binding, immutable_blocker, id_collision, active_run, already_satisfied, unsupported_origin, prerequisite_bound) instead of reason-word substrings

completion.summary: Pinned exact relation-refusal code/messages and added independent parent/grandparent ancestor-loop regressions with whole-store rollback checks.
